_doc: PROVISIONAL scene for real2sim (schema in sim/real2sim/scene.py). Values from the understand-phase reports; <ds>.calib.json (CALIB) and <ds>.servo.json (MUJOCO) override.
frame: URDF base frame: the 'base' body of so101_calib.xml at identity; SI units

joint_offsets.source: provisional: zero (repo convention, identity degrees). Evidence says otherwise: front silhouette fit9 elbow -2.8 deg (lift +0.19, wrist_flex -0.47, poorly determined); grasp-height fit pan +3.2, lift -0.35, elbow -2.1, wrist_flex -3.9 deg. CALIB fits these
joint_offsets._order: shoulder_pan, shoulder_lift, elbow_flex, wrist_flex, wrist_roll; q = radians(v + offset)

gripper_map.source: estimated: tick_physical candidate (joint_units report §4): 15.2 ticks/% x 360/4096 deg, anchored at the shut stop 2049 ticks = URDF Jaw -11.5 deg (finger meshes touch)

limits.source: computed: the follower calibration's firmware position limits through the lerobot DEGREES / RANGE_0_100 formulas (units.limits_rad); exceed the URDF on 4 joints

table.source: estimated: +20 mm, plausible +10..+30 mm (cameras report §3): base mesh bottom +30.1, raw-FK lowest fingertip <= 10.9, with elbow -2.8 deg <= 20.2, wrist-ray triangulation ~30

front.source: spec: Logitech C270 overhead, 640x480 as recorded (meta/info.json)

intrinsics.source: measured: ChArUco (990.4/997.0, RMS 0.27) and a render fit agree; sim_agent101 cameras.json front; trusted (cameras report §2)

distortion.source: conflict: cameras.json front coefficients, SUSPECT (p1 0.023, k3 6.6); silhouettes fit equally with or without them; 4-6 mm on the table

pose.source: fitted: fit6r, MuJoCo silhouettes of FK(observation.state) vs white-PLA masks, IoU 0.750 train / 0.676 held-out ep2, 1-2 mm repeatable across episodes, with this K and dist on undistorted frames (cameras report §2)

grip.source: spec: Klip Xtreme KWC-500 wrist camera on the printed klip_support, 640x480 as recorded

intrinsics.source: measured: INITIAL GUESS ONLY -- ChArUco on the 40 saved wrist images (sim/outputs/calib/wrist_*.png), RMS 0.69 px; the board never covered the bottom-left/jaw region (cameras report §1). Not the cameras.json grip entry

distortion.source: measured: INITIAL GUESS ONLY -- same ChArUco solve (full 5-coefficient)

pose.source: read: INITIAL GUESS ONLY -- mjlab klip_camera.py _CAM_POS/_CAM_RPY_DEG (fitted there with fx 487; dolly-zoom-ambiguous by 2-3 cm), intrinsic XYZ euler, MuJoCo camera axes -> OpenCV by diag(1,-1,-1); verified in tests/test_camera.py

cap.source: conflict: diameter 23-26 mm from the blocked jaw (finger-mesh gap) vs 28.7-32.1 mm from front pixels; 29 mm provisional. height 12 mm, wall 1.2, top 1.5 mm, mass 2.5 g assumed (not measurable from the data)

mug.source: estimated: outer diameter 83+-4 mm and height 100+-10 mm from the rim circle and red silhouette (episodes report); wall 3 mm, floor 5 mm, mass 0.30 kg assumed

handle.source: estimated: handle-blob centroid 59-60 mm from the axis, so it protrudes >= 18 mm; 20 mm used; attachment heights and 8 mm tube assumed

actuator.source: provisional: MuJoCo servo fit (joint_units report §5): reproduces observation.state from action at RMSE 0.29/1.49/1.56/0.47/0.34 deg; MUJOCO owns <ds>.servo.json
actuator.model: position servo with joint damping (not actuator velocity bias)

effort_limit.source: spec: STS3215 stall 1.91 N.m at 7.4 V, 2.94 at 12 V; supply voltage unknown; gripper Max_Torque_Limit 50 %

actuator.gripper_drive: drive the Jaw from the recorded ACTION (the state is blocked by the cap)

outcome.source: measured: episodes report (all six picks ended in the mug)

caps.source: estimated: front-pixel centroid (episodes report, teal mask, frame 0) unprojected with fit6r + trusted K + suspect dist onto z = table + cap height/2; ~5-8 mm typical, 15 mm at frame edges (cameras report §2), plus 0.32 mm per mm of table-height error

mug.source: estimated: rim-circle centre (episodes report, ring-brightness fit) unprojected with fit6r at z = table + mug height; handle yaw from the handle-blob centroid unprojected at the handle's mid height; the mug did not move (rim within 1 px all episode)

picks.source: measured: episodes report phase tables (gripper plateaus, FK, wrist-camera teal drop)
